categories.main_business_segments: CBRE operates through three primary business segments: Advisory Services (including leasing, capital markets, property management, and valuation), Global Workplace Solutions (integrated facilities and project management outsourcing for occupiers), and Real Estate Investments (investment management and development services). There is also a Corporate and Other segment for central functions and non-core investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CBRE leverages proprietary technologies for data management, analysis, and valuation, as well as digital platforms for facilities and project management. The company utilizes advanced analytics, market research, and technology-enabled service delivery, and has developed proprietary systems for valuation and investment analysis. Project management and development services are supported by specialized methodologies and digital tools, including those from Turner & Townsend.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CBRE serves a highly diversified client base, including real estate investors (such as pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, and other institutional investors) and occupiers (corporate, government, healthcare, retail, and industrial clients). Major end markets include office, industrial, retail, healthcare, life sciences, infrastructure, and residential real estate.
categories.geographic_coverage: CBRE operates in more than 100 countries, with significant presence in the Americas (especially the U.S.), Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Asia Pacific (APAC). In 2022, approximately 43% of revenue was generated outside the U.S., with major operations in the U.K., continental Europe, Australia, Canada, China, India, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: CBRE is primarily a downstream service provider, operating at the interface between property owners/investors and occupiers/tenants. In development and investment management, it may act as a principal or co-investor, but its core business is delivering services and solutions to end users and asset owners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: CBRE's strategic priorities include expanding stable, recurring revenue streams (especially outsourcing and investment management), investing in technology and digital platforms, driving operational efficiency, and pursuing strategic acquisitions. The company emphasizes innovation in data analytics, sustainability, and integrated service delivery, with ongoing R&D in digital tools, ESG solutions, and workplace transformation.
categories.revenue_model: CBRE generates revenue through a mix of stable, recurring sources (multi-year outsourcing and management contracts, investment management fees) and cyclical, transaction-based sources (commissions on property sales, leasing, and mortgage origination). Additional revenue streams include project management fees, development fees, and incentive-based compensation tied to investment performance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CBRE is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm by revenue, with leading global positions in leasing, property sales, outsourcing, and valuation. Major competitors include Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), Cushman & Wakefield, Colliers, Savills, Newmark, and sector specialists like Eastdil Secured, Marcus & Millichap, and Walker & Dunlop. The industry is highly fragmented and competitive, with both global and strong regional/local players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, CBRE generated $30.8 billion in revenue, with net income of $1.4 billion and core EBITDA of $2.9 billion. The company has a diversified and resilient revenue base, with significant growth in Global Workplace Solutions and stable performance in Advisory Services and Real Estate Investments. CBRE is ranked #126 on the Fortune 500 and has demonstrated a trajectory of growth through organic expansion and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CBRE emphasizes its ability to deliver integrated, account-based, and technology-enabled real estate solutions on a global scale, supported by deep market expertise, proprietary data, and a broad service offering. The company differentiates itself through its scale, brand recognition, ethical standards, and ability to provide end-to-end solutions for both investors and occupiers, including sustainability and ESG leadership.
